notes.title: More!
notes.content:
With this update, we have brought the total number of gameplay levels and cut scenes in the game to 20!
As usual, everything ends at the most interesting place - stay tuned, to be continued!

notes.title: Whistle everyone up! Fasten your seat belts!
notes.content:
The ship "Gertrude" with a team on board is going to early access! 

Already you are waiting for a pack of adrenaline levels filled with shootouts in outer space and the beginning of a story about the adventures of a gang of cheerful space pirates!

And the soundtrack of the game sets a special tone to everything that happens on the screen. It has all the facets of synth wave - from brutal smash-hits to epic space ambient. 

We also improved and refined the interface. It is now as convenient and intuitive as its main control console of Gertrude.

Do not leave our orbit, stay tuned - more is coming!
